description: A reasoning lens for honest persuasion — why a funnel stalls, which of the three certainties (product, seller, company) is weak, what objection is really a mask for, how to pre-empt it in copy, qualifying out bad fits, and translating live-call technique into asynchronous pages, ads and emails. Use when you say "sales-closer", "why isn't this converting", "they said they'd think about it", "what objection are we missing", "is the ask clear", or want a funnel or landing page diagnosed. Refuses to push an offer that doesn't deserve a yes. An abstract archetype, not modelled on or endorsed by any real person.
